agent.problem: The setup only says that a prayer goes up to the LORD; it gives no indication that the prayer confesses sin. The baker therefore cannot reason out 'rebellions' rather than 'enemies' or 'sorrows' and must guess the unseen wording of the line.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
